art_direction.background_logic: 用竖向接力带和大面积暗场组织页面，不复用前七期的纸张、地图、房间、proof sheet 或开放矩形
art_direction.behance_viewing_arc: 从衣服的使用语法进入身体差异，再转向录音与城市时间表

closing_palette.rationale: 深紫压低胜利宣言，冰白保留清醒阅读，琥珀只照亮那个仍可被使用的入口。

art_direction.core_visual_action: 一条信号从一个对象交到另一个对象，重点不是累积，而是进入方式发生变化
art_direction.cover_composition: 四条宽窄不同的竖带穿过暗色封面，日期与判断分别落在带内与带外
art_direction.desktop_interaction_mechanic: 原生索引与锚点始终可见，所有正文和来源不依赖 JavaScript
art_direction.dominant_mood: 深紫色接力台：四条琥珀色通道把服装、身体、录音与放映时间依次交接
art_direction.image_behavior: 四张一手官方媒体只在 Preview 外链显示；本地 SVG 是原创失图占位，不伪装成现场照片
art_direction.mobbin_usability_constraint: 交互目标不少于 44px，焦点可见，外图失败仍保留来源与权利说明
art_direction.mobile_translation: 390px 下竖带收成顶部色条，内容单列，无横向滚动
art_direction.page_density_and_tempo: 开场密集、正文四段逐步放松，最后以短句退出
art_direction.quiet_ending: 新意不宣布胜利，只留下一个可被使用的入口
art_direction.type_scale_logic: 窄体标题沿竖带切分，正文保持 18px；编号像接力棒一样停在每段入口前

editorial_position: 新并不等于多一点；真正有效的发布，会改变衣服、身体、声音与城市时间被人进入的方式。
limitations: Backfill candidate and non-production Preview input only; this manifest cannot authorize production deployment.
Canonical private GUAiZzz/harry-tone main was verified at pinned commit 13cd6b7046bd81be396810d2923f3a5dc818e93f from a fresh ephemeral workspace; no private material enters this repository.

All selected stories use externally hosted first-party official images. Reuse rights remain unknown, so candidate status stays BLOCKED and Preview displays source links and local non-documentary fallbacks.

All five regional lanes, the full 99-subject registry quick scan, the japan focus cohort and all standing beats were checked; the public radar contains 10 distinct items and applies the prior-two-issue lookback.
Named editorial, visual and rights review remains unresolved; owner instruction authorizes only the existing non-production Preview after technical and privacy gates pass.
